answer: No anneal-line badge is cut until a live coercivity sweep is scored. An applicant stakes 35 coins and clamps a clerk-serialized 8 mm ferrous coupon, faced with an ivory wafer, onto yoke 3 of licensed line F, whose B-H table is on-ledger. For 14 minutes a 0.6 tesla coil cycles the coupon while a roof beacon flashes a two-second mark at each peak. Peers accept only if residual magnetism stays within 4 percent of the posted loop and the wafer serial is unused. A shared coupon or reused wafer burns the bond and closes the bay for two epochs.
